greeting: Morning, Nyla — coffee's on. Your Berlin listeners just overtook LA overnight, so let's talk about it.
headline: Lean into the Germany spike before it cools — one targeted post and one curator pitch this week could turn a blip into a base.

analytics_insight.observation: Berlin moved into your #1 city this week, up 38% in 14 days, while your US numbers stayed flat. That kind of organic regional pull usually means a playlist add or a sync you weren't tracking — your sound is landing with the European late-night R&B crowd.
analytics_insight.action: Find the source: check Spotify for Artists 'Discovered On' this morning and screenshot the playlist driving it — we'll pitch its sister playlists.

today_tasks.task: Pull your 'Discovered On' playlists and send the top 3 to your PR agent
today_tasks.why: We can't pitch the Berlin momentum without knowing what's already carrying it.

today_tasks.task: Film one 9-second vertical clip of the 'Slow Hours' bridge in low light
today_tasks.why: That bridge is your most-replayed 30 seconds and it matches the late-night mood your new listeners came for.

today_tasks.task: Approve or tweak the two pitches in your PR queue
today_tasks.why: Nothing goes out without your okay, and the Berlin window won't stay open.

today_tasks.task: Reply to 5 comments on last week's Reel in your own voice
today_tasks.why: Your engagement rate dips when you go quiet for 3+ days, and the algorithm noticed.

items: Post the 'Slow Hours' Reel at 9pm CET to hit Berlin primetime
Reply to comments within the first 2 hours
Story poll: 'Slow Hours' vs 'Cold Glass' as next single
Carousel on the meaning behind 'Slow Hours'
DM any curator who added the track a thank-you
Tease next single's hook (audio only, no visuals yet)
Post to Threads where your replies do best
Reshare the best-performing clip of the week to Stories
10-min weekly check-in: what landed, what didn't, what changed

brand_note.insight: Your whole identity is intimacy at 2am — sparse production, one voice, no shouting. The Berlin audience confirms that lane is real and ownable.
brand_note.guidance: Keep your grid in that world: low light, single light source, muted blues and warm amber. Resist the urge to post a hype 'numbers are up!' graphic — it breaks the spell. Let the work stay quiet and confident; that restraint IS the brand.

content_calendar.caption: i wrote this bridge at 3am and almost cut it. glad i didn't. 'Slow Hours' out now. which line hits hardest?
content_calendar.visual_direction: Phone on a surface, low warm lamp, you lip-syncing only the bridge. No cuts. Let it be still — your stillness is the aesthetic.

content_calendar.hook: POV: it's 2am in Berlin and this comes on
content_calendar.caption: apparently y'all in Germany found me first 🥹 'Slow Hours' is for the late ones. #fyp
content_calendar.visual_direction: Same clip recut vertical with a soft text overlay. Geo-leaning caption to ride the Berlin wave you already have.

content_calendar.caption: swipe for the story behind it. some of these lines are about a 4am drive i still think about. thank you for listening this closely.
content_calendar.visual_direction: 4-5 slides: a lyric per slide over your existing photo set from the cover shoot. Reuse assets — no new shoot needed.

content_calendar.hook: should the next one be slower or colder?
content_calendar.caption: sitting on two demos. one's a slow burn, one's got a colder edge. genuinely torn — what do you want next?
content_calendar.visual_direction: Text post with a 12-second audio snippet of the next single's hook. Threads is where your replies convert — ask a real question.

pr_opportunities.target: Curators of mid-size late-night/'bedroom R&B' Spotify playlists (5k–50k followers) in the German market
pr_opportunities.why_fit: Your Berlin spike means these editors' audiences are already primed for your sound — you're not cold-pitching, you're showing up where you're proven to work.
pr_opportunities.draft_pitch: Hi — I run an independent R&B project called Nyla. 'Slow Hours' has been quietly climbing in Berlin this month and I noticed your playlist lives in exactly that late-night lane. No pressure at all, but I think it'd sit naturally between the slower cuts you feature. Here's a private link — thank you for listening either way.

pr_opportunities.target: A small but tastemaking neo-soul/R&B blog or newsletter that covers emerging artists
pr_opportunities.why_fit: Blogs at this tier love a 'discovered abroad first' angle — your Germany story is a genuine hook, not manufactured.
pr_opportunities.draft_pitch: Hey — quick one. I'm an indie R&B artist and something strange happened: my track 'Slow Hours' took off in Berlin before it did at home. Thought the 'found in Germany first' angle might be a fun emerging-artist story for your readers. Track + a couple lines about how it happened attached if useful. Appreciate your time.
